title: Surreal Alien Wanderer
description: A surreal black and white illustration split into two realms. The upper half shows a tall humanoid figure with a large cracked sphere containing three stylized eyes for a head, standing atop a mountain range while holding a glowing red orb that drips; the lower half depicts a vibrant purple lavender field on the left and two large green-spotted alien creatures with big eyes on the right side of a winding path.
